\documentclass[11pt]{article}\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}\newtheorem{remark}{Remark}
\title{An Exact Centered-Star Repair and Its Entropy Cost}\author{}\date{21 July 2026}\begin{document}\maketitle
\begin{abstract}We construct the natural radial repair on the fifteen-dimensional centered tangent space of a six-staple $SU(2)$ star and retain its complete Jacobian entropy.\end{abstract}
For $x=(x_1,\ldots,x_m)\in(\mathbb R^c)^m$, write $\bar x=m^{-1}\sum_i x_i$ and define
\[T_a(x)_i=\bar x+a(x_i-\bar x),\qquad 0<a<1.\]
\begin{theorem}The map preserves the mean, is equivariant under common orthogonal adjoint action, multiplies centered dispersion by $a^2$, and has determinant $a^{c(m-1)}$ on the centered fiber. If the bad RMS is at least $\eta$, then for Gaussian weight $e^{-D/(2t)}$ its ideal repair free energy is
\[F_{\rm star}={(1-a^2)m\eta^2\over2t}-c(m-1)\log(1/a).\]
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}The mean and scaling identities follow by direct substitution. The centered subspace has dimension $c(m-1)$, giving the determinant. The action difference is at least $(1-a^2)m\eta^2/(2t)$; change of variables supplies the Jacobian loss.\end{proof}
The frozen six-staple, three-color tangent repair exceeds the allocated free-energy target even after its fifteen-dimensional Jacobian is charged.
\begin{remark}This map acts on independently represented staple coordinates. A lift to actual link variables may create curvature outside the star and is not asserted here.\end{remark}\end{document}
